mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_likes cl WHERE cl.content_id = c.content_id), 0) AS like_count, 0 AS view_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_places cp WHERE cp.content_id = c.content_id), 0) AS related_place_count, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM content_likes cl2 WHERE cl2.content_id = c.content_id AND cl2.user_id = #{userId} ) END AS is_liked FROM contents c
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM contents WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' AND (status IS NULL OR status != 'DELETED') ORDER BY category ASC
WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId} AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status != 'DELETED')

SELECT c.*, 0 AS like_count, 0 AS view_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_places cp WHERE cp.content_id = c.content_id), 0) AS related_place_count, FALSE AS is_liked FROM contents c WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId}

SELECT p.*, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_likes pl WHERE pl.place_id = p.place_id), 0) AS like_count, FALSE AS is_liked, NULL AS visit_status FROM places p JOIN content_places cp ON cp.place_id = p.place_id WHERE cp.content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY cp.sort_order ASC, p.place_name ASC
JOIN content_places cp ON cp.content_id = c.content_id WHERE cp.place_id = #{placeId} AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status != 'DELETED') ORDER BY cp.sort_order ASC, c.title ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE contents SET title = #{title}, category = #{category}, subcategory = #{subcategory}, release_year = #{releaseYear}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, cast_names = #{castNames}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, is_popular = #{popular}, country = #{country}, ott_platform = #{ottPlatform}, tags = #{tags} WHERE content_id = #{contentId}
UPDATE contents SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE content_id = #{contentId}
